_comment: DTA strategy constants. ALL FROZEN — there is no learning loop for DTA (tuning a ~0.3-0.5 Sharpe signal on tens of trades fits noise). Change these by hand only, with a written reason, and re-validate on paper. See CLAUDE.md section 10.
_satellite_note: The momentum satellite is OFF by default. Turn it on only AFTER the DTA core clears the paper-validation checklist in MIGRATION_CHECKLIST.md. It is hard-capped to 20% of the book, 8% per name, 2 per sector, and only runs when the market regime is risk-on (SPY above its 200d trend).
